name: python-conventions
description: Always-on Python correctness rules: raw strings/forward slashes for Windows paths interpolated into one-liners, json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode() for trailing-data JSON files, forced UTF-8 plus file-redirected re-fetch verification for Python-backed CLIs on Windows consoles, and plain ASCII punctuation instead of HTML entities in scripted Azure CLI ticket updates.

origin.note: Distilled from four 2026-08 incident notes captured during Azure DevOps scripting and tool-output processing work: a backslash-in-one-liner path silently misread as escape sequences, an 'Extra data' json.load() failure caused by trailing non-JSON content rather than corruption, a cp1252 UnicodeEncodeError/silent-corruption trap in az rest/az boards on Windows, and az boards work-item update silently stripping HTML entities from text fields.
